item.title: 俠盜獵車手6發售 大批社畜告假搶劫去！遊戲太紅反而排擠其他電玩？新作太Woke 引發「無毒男子氣概」討論？【TODAY 看世界】
item.itunes:title: 俠盜獵車手6發售 大批社畜告假搶劫去！遊戲太紅反而排擠其他電玩？新作太Woke 引發「無毒男子氣概」討論？【TODAY 看世界】
item.itunes:author: TODAY 看世界
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AlwRnjewT6U

值得閱讀的理由

  • 見證娛樂史新紀錄：深入了解《俠盜獵車手6》（GTA 6）如何以首日近38億美元的驚人營收，超越好萊塢頂級票房與流行音樂巡演，成為全球經濟事件。
  • 透視遊戲產業資源失衡與排擠效應：探討頂級3A大作長達八年、耗資15億美元的極致手工打磨，如何對中小型遊戲廠商帶來生存衝擊與排擠風險。
  • 解析當代流行文化與性別敘事轉向：觀察本作如何首度引入女主角、轉向「無毒男子氣概」，並在社群引發關於政治正確與沉浸式玩法的廣泛討論。

摘要

現象級大作回歸與破紀錄的經濟狂潮

歷經十三年的漫長等待，《俠盜獵車手6》（GTA 6）終於正式發售，作者指出這款遊戲已從單純的電玩娛樂躍升為一場全球性的經濟事件。遊戲以邁阿密為藍本重現「罪惡城」，並首度採用雙主角制，讓女主角露西亞與男主角組成宛如現代版我倆沒有明天的亡命鴛鴦。發售首日，GTA 6 便創下高達37.9億美元的全球銷售額，不僅刷新影視娛樂史上的所有紀錄，更一舉超越《復仇者聯盟4》的影史票房與泰勒絲的巡迴演唱會收益。

「GTA流感」蔓延與慢活迷因文化

遊戲熱潮迅速席捲全球職場，引發大批社畜以各種理由告假的「GTA流感」現象，估計造成各國數以億計的工時經濟損失。有趣的是，作者觀察到許多苦候多年的老玩家在進入遊戲後，並未立刻展開犯罪狂歡，反而在極度細緻的世界中體驗洗車、漫步海灘等慢節奏生活，讓硬派犯罪遊戲變成了「佛系模擬市民」，在社群網路上形成熱烈探討的全新迷因。

頂級製作引發的產業排擠與手工匠人精神

GTA 6 的空前成功背後，是母公司歷時八年、動用約4,700名人力並砸下近15億美元的龐大資源。這種巨額投資不僅迫使同期其他遊戲大廠紛紛延期避開檔期，更凸顯了現今遊戲產業兩極化的生存危機。值得注意的是，團隊在開發過程中堅持不使用生成式AI，所有街景互動、NPC行為模式與對白皆由人工細心雕琢，以極致的手工藝水準樹立了數位娛樂的難以逾越之標竿。

風格轉向與諷刺美國夢的文化符號

針對內容層面，本作調整了過去常遭詬病的爭議性內容，展現出更具深度的「無毒男子氣概」，雖然在玩家社群中掀起關於「過度政治正確（Woke）」與敘事進步的兩極論戰，但也展現出系列作品與時俱進的野心。作者最後總結，該系列最迷人之處，始終在於其辛辣諷刺美國夢與社會荒謬的文化核心，而在業界頻傳裁員與轉型焦慮的當下，這款史詩級巨作既是奇蹟，也是對傳統遊戲時代的一記深遠回響。

=============

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AlwRnjewT6U

粉絲苦等13年，俠盜獵車手6（GTA 6）11/19終於開賣了！上市第一天就創下38億美元營收，全球粉絲各種理由請假玩遊戲導致經濟損失破億。GTA6為何已經不只是一款遊戲，而是一個全球性的經濟事件？這次團隊完全沒有用生成式AI來製作，逼真畫面讓粉絲讚嘆，但也讓專家擔心未來能做出這種品質的公司越來越少，遊戲時代恐怕終結。

item.title: 請辭11天閃電回鍋！輝達董事會為何突然軟化？川普自誇神救援 黃仁勳背後還有哪些硬仗？【TODAY看世界】
item.itunes:title: 請辭11天閃電回鍋！輝達董事會為何突然軟化？川普自誇神救援 黃仁勳背後還有哪些硬仗？【TODAY看世界】
item.itunes:author: TODAY 看世界
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6YG2YKDtH2Y

值得閱讀的理由

  • 解析黃仁勳在閃辭後僅短短11天內戲劇性重返輝達執行長寶座的幕後轉折。
  • 揭秘川普政府如何透過跨部會施壓與地緣政治考量，促成輝達董事會立場的驚人大逆轉。
  • 全面剖析黃仁勳回歸後即將面臨的嚴格內部監管、司法部反壟斷調查與美國國會聽證風暴。

摘要

社群迷因狂潮與重返輝達總部

主持人范琪斐指出，黃仁勳重返輝達（NVIDIA）的消息引爆了全球網路社群的熱烈討論與迷因創作。從將其比擬為「甄嬛回宮」到戲稱請假打遊戲結束，甚至連台灣社群也瘋傳各式AI生成圖與惡搞封面。當黃仁勳親自重返輝達總部時，現場湧入大量員工熱烈歡呼，人氣絲毫不減。他在致詞中幽默自嘲自己連電腦都還沒領到，並坦誠承認過去犯下的嚴重錯誤，向眾人致歉並承諾會成為更好的執行長。

川普介入與董事會態度大逆轉

令人困惑的是，董事會在黃仁勳於11月12日辭職後原本態度極為強硬，甚至公開表態絕無復職計劃。然而，短短數天內情勢急遽變化。除了矽谷發起超過18萬人簽署的「聲援黃仁勳」（Stand with Jensen）連署之外，關鍵推手正是美國總統川普。在司法部確認黃仁勳並無違法事證後，川普動員了副總統、財政部長及商務部長全力遊說董事會。川普更透露，在與中國領導人會晤後，擔憂若美國處置過當會導致黃仁勳被中國挖角，加上輝達股價大跌的現實壓力，最終促成董事會一致同意迎回黃仁勳。

重返職位背後的重重調查與國會風暴

儘管重獲職位，黃仁勳的挑戰才剛開始。輝達董事會不僅設立了「國家安全與出口管制委員會」，增設法規遵循長並嚴加審查外國情報機構接觸風險；同時，美國商務部正就其關聯公司涉嫌違規轉運晶片至中國進行出口管制調查，司法部也正推進針對搭售軟硬體與高額收購案的反壟斷調查。更為嚴峻的是，黃仁勳即將面臨美國國會眾議院與參議院的高壓聽證會質詢，國會調查權將直接檢視各項內部決策與政府背書的合理性，未來的法規與政治角力依舊暗潮洶湧。

================================================

I know everyone only cares about one thing today: Jensen is back. There's a lot of online discussion, so we'll break it down into a few points. First, the online reaction is incredibly heated; this short clip on Twitter perfectly captures how I and many other shareholders feel! Since there are so many creative ones, we’ve picked a few particularly inspired examples to share. Second, why did the NVIDIA board, which was so dead set on getting Jensen Huang to leave, suddenly make a U-turn? What's the key? Trump claims it’s all thanks to him—do you believe it? Third, Jensen’s return doesn't mean his troubles are over; there are still plenty of battles ahead. The DOJ, the NVIDIA board, and Congress all say they’re investigating—which one is the toughest? Could they find something that forces NVIDIA to cut ties with Jensen again? Fourth, what about his wife Lori’s reaction? The whole world has forgiven Jensen, but has Lori forgiven him too? https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6YG2YKDtH2Y

值得閱讀的理由

  • 解析黃仁勳在閃辭後僅短短11天內戲劇性重返輝達執行長寶座的幕後轉折。
  • 揭秘川普政府如何透過跨部會施壓與地緣政治考量，促成輝達董事會立場的驚人大逆轉。
  • 全面剖析黃仁勳回歸後即將面臨的嚴格內部監管、司法部反壟斷調查與美國國會聽證風暴。

摘要

社群迷因狂潮與重返輝達總部

主持人范琪斐指出，黃仁勳重返輝達（NVIDIA）的消息引爆了全球網路社群的熱烈討論與迷因創作。從將其比擬為「甄嬛回宮」到戲稱請假打遊戲結束，甚至連台灣社群也瘋傳各式AI生成圖與惡搞封面。當黃仁勳親自重返輝達總部時，現場湧入大量員工熱烈歡呼，人氣絲毫不減。他在致詞中幽默自嘲自己連電腦都還沒領到，並坦誠承認過去犯下的嚴重錯誤，向眾人致歉並承諾會成為更好的執行長。

川普介入與董事會態度大逆轉

令人困惑的是，董事會在黃仁勳於11月12日辭職後原本態度極為強硬，甚至公開表態絕無復職計劃。然而，短短數天內情勢急遽變化。除了矽谷發起超過18萬人簽署的「聲援黃仁勳」（Stand with Jensen）連署之外，關鍵推手正是美國總統川普。在司法部確認黃仁勳並無違法事證後，川普動員了副總統、財政部長及商務部長全力遊說董事會。川普更透露，在與中國領導人會晤後，擔憂若美國處置過當會導致黃仁勳被中國挖角，加上輝達股價大跌的現實壓力，最終促成董事會一致同意迎回黃仁勳。

重返職位背後的重重調查與國會風暴

儘管重獲職位，黃仁勳的挑戰才剛開始。輝達董事會不僅設立了「國家安全與出口管制委員會」，增設法規遵循長並嚴加審查外國情報機構接觸風險；同時，美國商務部正就其關聯公司涉嫌違規轉運晶片至中國進行出口管制調查，司法部也正推進針對搭售軟硬體與高額收購案的反壟斷調查。更為嚴峻的是，黃仁勳即將面臨美國國會眾議院與參議院的高壓聽證會質詢，國會調查權將直接檢視各項內部決策與政府背書的合理性，未來的法規與政治角力依舊暗潮洶湧。

================================================

I know everyone only cares about one thing today: Jensen is back. There's a lot of online discussion, so we'll break it down into a few points. First, the online reaction is incredibly heated; this short clip on Twitter perfectly captures how I and many other shareholders feel! Since there are so many creative ones, we’ve picked a few particularly inspired examples to share. Second, why did the NVIDIA board, which was so dead set on getting Jensen Huang to leave, suddenly make a U-turn? What's the key? Trump claims it’s all thanks to him—do you believe it? Third, Jensen’s return doesn't mean his troubles are over; there are still plenty of battles ahead. The DOJ, the NVIDIA board, and Congress all say they’re investigating—which one is the toughest? Could they find something that forces NVIDIA to cut ties with Jensen again? Fourth, what about his wife Lori’s reaction? The whole world has forgiven Jensen, but has Lori forgiven him too? Finally, we will talk about what Jensen’s return means. Hello everyone, I’m Fan Fei, welcome to "Fan Fei’s World." Let’s start light and look at the various creative memes online. This sudden U-turn by the board had many netizens feeling emotional. Some even joked, "Jensen, did you finish GTA 6 and come back to work?" If you wanted a vacation, just say so—don't make such a big scene! Taiwanese social media was also immediately flooded with various AI-generated images. Like this one: " Let's see who will be my successor?""Ha , it's me!" Jay Chou's album cover was.

even edited to say, "Jensen, you're back ." Someone else mimicked an AI-generated thumbnail: "Three days later, the board begged me to return while crying." Exactly, but my personal favorite is this "Jensen Returns to the Palace" series. Concubine Zhen took three years to return to the palace; Concubine Jensen only took 11 days! This series could practically be a sticker pack! And this—I was just looking to switch to an iPhone, and now I have an even better reason. Unfolding the phone and seeing Jensen instantly brings a sense of comfort. Someone even adapted scenes from The Matrix; the plot and character. designs are absolutely brilliant! Right , NVIDIA graphics cards are great—keep using them; that's what AI computing power should be used for! And Jensen himself has publicly stated that he can't wait to get back to work. Back at NVIDIA headquarters, crowds of employees poured out from every corner to cheer him on, showing his popularity remains undiminished. Jensen gave a brief speech , jokingly remarking that this was his first day on the job and he didn't even have a computer yet, waiting for the IT department to set him up with a new one . He then candidly admitted to making serious mistakes, apologized to everyone. , and thanked them for giving him a second chance, promising to be an even better CEO this time. However, Taiwanese netizens are more concerned about whether Jensen's seniority and paid leave have been reset to zero. Does a newbie have to buy coffee for everyone on their first day? New hires aren't supposed to perform for the bosses until they've been there three months, and they aren't even eligible for the raffle—not that a bubble tea party would save him. Anyway , it's hard to say if he'll even pass probation, but don't you find it strange ? Wasn't it less than a week ago that the NVIDIA board firmly stated they wouldn't let Jensen Huang return?

What on earth happened in these short 11 days? Actually, the day after Jensen resigned on November 12, Silicon Valley launched a campaign called "Stand with Jensen," involving current and former employees, investors, and even Elon Musk joined in . According to Reuters, over 180,000 people signed the petition. On the 17th, for the first time since resigning, Jensen publicly stated he was willing to return as CEO, but he was ruthlessly rejected by the board during that day's earnings call, with them saying they had no plans for his. reinstatement. Then someone stepped in: US President Trump. I'll explain what was said later, but the next day, the NVIDIA board actually ... Originally, the NVIDIA board's stance was very tough, saying Jensen had to go . Why the sudden change? And they were even in unanimous agreement. According to reports from the New York Times and The Wall Street Journal, this past weekend was critical. After Trump learned from the Department. of Justice that there was no evidence of wrongdoing by Jensen, he began a full-scale lobbying effort toward the NVIDIA board. In an exclusive interview with CNBC, Trump mentioned that he not only communicated directly and indirectly with the board but also brought in the Vice President, Treasury Secretary, and Commerce Secretary to mediate. He also said that if he had made the call a few days earlier, it might not have been so easy to convince the board, but seeing NVIDIA's stock price plummet made things much easier. As for the board's biggest concern regarding national security, the Trump administration gave them full assurances.

. He believes Jensen won't affect national security, though he didn't rule it out entirely and made no explicit promise that Jensen wouldn't be prosecuted. However, what Trump is truly worried about isn't just the stock market. He said that while attending the APEC summit in China last week, he spent quite some time talking about Jensen Huang with Xi Jinping. Although Xi Jinping didn't know much about Jensen Huang, he praised him as very intelligent, which made him worry that if the U.S. treated Huang too poorly, China might just poach him to run Huawei or something similar. But when reporters pressed him on whether there was any. indication that China actually intended to poach him, Trump admitted there was none at all; in his view, however, letting Jensen Huang continue to lead NVIDIA is not a national security risk. Losing Jensen Huang would be, but doesn't a U.S. President intervening directly in a public company's personnel decisions have any boundaries? If it were AI giants like Microsoft, Google, OpenAI, or Anthropic in trouble today, would Trump jump in to intervene as well ? Trump actually brought up his favorite pastime, golf, saying it’s just like the game—it requires touch and feel to get. the ball to the right spot, meaning the government’s interference in private business is entirely situational. Moving forward, Jensen Huang still has several tough battles to fight. First, according to NVIDIA's statement, a committee of independent directors and external lawyers will clarify whether Jensen Huang has been targeted by foreign intelligence agencies; even though he is reinstated, the investigation will continue. The board has also established a National Security and Export Control.

Committee, bringing in experts to ensure the company follows trade regulations and avoids crossing national security red lines; additionally, a Chief Compliance Officer position has been created to oversee company-wide adherence and report directly to the board's governance committee. This means that although Jensen Huang has regained his position, he will face much stricter oversight from the board upon his return. Furthermore, investigations by the U.S. Department of Justice and the Department of Commerce are far from over, and they are proceeding on two fronts. The first is. an export control investigation, tracking whether Megaspe—a company where Huang once worked—illegally transshipped NVIDIA chips to China; on the day Huang was reinstated, the Department of Commerce even added Megaspe and six other companies to an export blacklist. The other is an antitrust investigation launched by the Justice Department earlier; on one hand, they are checking if NVIDIA used its chip shortage to tie in sales of its other products, and on the other, whether its plan to spend $ 12.9 billion to acquire the AI open-source platform Hugging Face will. make it even more dominant is also a key focus. Beyond the DOJ and the Department of Commerce, agencies like the FBI are also continuing to investigate Huang, and the SEC is looking into whether NVIDIA’s information disclosures have misled investors. Finally, there is the congressional investigation. Jensen Huang is scheduled to face a closed-door questioning by three joint House committees on December 1st, followed by Nvidia’s Chief Legal Officer the next day. Both sessions will have transcripts, and on December 3rd,.

Huang is set to appear before the Senate . During the Banking Committee’s public hearing—an investigative hearing regarding alleged illegal activities or misconduct—the atmosphere is usually at its most tense, with lawmakers often relentlessly demanding that the individual involved provide clear answers. At this point, you might wonder : Nvidia is a private company, does the U.S. Congress really have that much power? Actually, it is quite significant . The U.S. Supreme Court has ruled that investigations are an indispensable part of Congress exercising its legislative. power, because how can Congress draft effective laws if it doesn’t even know where the problems lie? As long as there is a legitimate legislative purpose and it falls within a committee's jurisdiction, congressional investigative power is quite broad. Not only can they demand answers, internal documents, emails, and meeting minutes, but they can also issue subpoenas when necessary to compel relevant individuals to testify. If one refuses to cooperate without cause, Congress can even seek court enforcement or refer the case to the Department of Justice to pursue contempt of Congress charges. Furthermore, the targets of. congressional investigations are not just private companies; even the White House and executive departments cannot hide. In other words, even if Trump personally endorses Jensen Huang, Congress still has the right to demand that the government explain exactly what information it based its judgment on to determine that Huang poses no national security risk. Of course, the President can claim executive privilege and refuse to disclose certain internal decision-making information, but this privilege is not absolute; if necessary , it can lead to litigation, with courts intervening to resolve the matter.

So, even with Trump’s endorsement, Congress will investigate what it needs to. Whether Jensen Huang can truly emerge unscathed remains to be seen. Everything discussed so far concerns the operations of the company, the board, and the White House, but can Jensen Huang’s family simply let go of his affair? In the final sentence of Huang’s statement, he says, "I am grateful for the love and support of my family." It is worth noting that he expresses gratitude to his family without offering further apologies for the affair. Does this mean he has secured their. forgiveness? The most important factor, of course, is the attitude of his wife, Lori. So, has she forgiven him? You should know that these tech CEOs 'wives are not like the "糟糠 妻"(long-suffering wives) of the past; their capabilities are often on par with their husbands, and they usually chose to focus on the family for the sake of their children. What’s more, Lori herself holds a significant amount of Nvidia stock, and there are even rumors that she played a key role in Jensen Huang’s return this time. According to news reports, Jensen Huang and Lori have reached an " understanding," which means the two have already reached a consensus regarding this crisis. Looking at Taiwan, the。stock market surged over 3,300 points today, with many stocks including TSMC hitting the daily limit, making them impossible to buy. But looking back, the Taiwan government has been busy. Despite activating the National Security Fund on November 6 and issuing three rounds of short-selling restrictions, the market still plummeted 17.5%last week. The Executive Yuan is now debating whether to expand the 500-billion-NTD fund, which has remained unchanged for 26 years. However, while the stock market has been.

in chaos, Taiwan's AI-related businesses seem largely unaffected. Even before Jensen Huang’s return, NVIDIA had been expanding its cooperation with the Taiwanese supply chain. Just last week, through cash investments and long-term contracts, they expanded capacity for substrates, advanced packaging, and foundry services to support AI infrastructure, with companies like TSMC and Foxconn among them. Moreover, only 11 days after "the Emperor returned to the palace," NVIDIA’s high-end roadmap for Blackwell. , Rubin, and Fireman remains unchanged. GPU iteration speeds will not slow down , and supply chain allocation will see no significant shifts, with orders secured through 2027 and some mass production reaching into 2028. As for the pace of U.S. AI development and U.S. -China relations, they still impact Taiwan. A senior executive in the semiconductor packaging and testing supply chain noted that while we must monitor if U.S. data center construction is slowing, the competition between the U.S. and China in AI computing power and national strength will only intensify. A senior economist at DBS Bank in Singapore warned that AI industry regulations might tighten after the U.S. midterm elections, especially since many planned data centers have not yet obtained construction or power permits, leaving future investment scales with significant variables. Le Monde also recently reported that TSMC alone accounts for about 40%of Taiwan's total market capitalization, and in the popular 0050 ETF, TSMC’s weighting exceeds half. So, this "Jensen Huang storm" serves as a wake-up call for.

Taiwan. When a personnel change at one American company can turn our stock market upside down, the government should ask: what if one day it isn't Huang who has a problem , but the entire AI industry fails to meet growth expectations? Does Taiwan have other economic engines to support us? I feel that while " Consort Huang" has returned to the palace, the drama is far from over, and now we must see how he plays his next moves.
